title: 99% Initiative (popular initiative for the taxation of capital income)
description: Popular initiative launched by the JUSO to tax capital income above a threshold at 150%, redirecting revenue to low and middle incomes. As SP co-president, Wermuth was a leading supporter; the SP contributed about CHF 60,000 to the campaign.

title: Responsible Business Initiative (Konzernverantwortungsinitiative)
description: Popular initiative requiring Swiss-based companies to be held liable for human-rights and environmental violations abroad. Supported by the SP; Wermuth was a public advocate in debates.
status: Gained a majority of voters but failed for lack of a majority of cantons

title: Referendum against the abolition of the issuance stamp duty (Stempelsteuer reform)
description: The SP under Wermuth co-led a referendum against a corporate tax relief abolishing the issuance stamp duty.
status: Referendum successful; the reform was rejected by voters

title: COVID-19 Act (federal law)
description: Wermuth voted in favour of the COVID-19 Act, advocating vaccination as the key measure to end the pandemic while expressing personal reservations about COVID certificates.
